reuse.why: Replaces the actions' own category queries with one getMonthWideTargetCategories and keeps using the existing getBudgetData, setBudget and isTrackingBudget unchanged.

duplication.why: Three copies of the visible-categories SQL, setZero's query and copyPreviousMonth's hidden check collapse into one query; nothing new is duplicated.

placement.why: The selection lives in budget/actions.ts beside the month-wide actions that use it, as a plain db query like its neighbours.

scope.why: Focused on the requested exclusion rule; it leaves the now-unused hidden/group_hidden columns in getBudgetData's query and type.

maintainability.why: A short, documented single query decides which categories month-wide actions touch, so adding another exclusion is a one-line change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five month-wide actions use getMonthWideTargetCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the copies are removed into one function.

one_place.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories in server/budget/actions.ts holds the hidden, hidden-group and saved-template rule for copyPreviousMonth, setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg.
